concerns.text: FR-010 specifies that the external hold‑out metric must be computed as the proportion of performance gain over the linear baseline attributable to pairwise interactions using permutation of interaction pairs. The plan instead defines the metric as (R²_full − R²_main)/R²_full based on a depth‑1 main‑effects‑only model, which does not match the required permutation‑based formulation.

The plan mentions an “independent external hold‑out” but does not state that this hold‑out must be sourced from the DOE Materials Data Repository as required by FR-010; the source of the hold‑out data is left unspecified.

Constitution Principle I (Single Source of Truth) requires an explicit designation of the SSoT artifact (e.g., the project state YAML). The plan only states “Every figure/statistic traces to one row…”, but does not name the SSoT file, which is a missing explicit reference.
